comments.author: RaiRaiTheRaichu Staff
comments.body_html:
Before you leave a comment or write me a message on Discord, PLEASE READ THIS FIRST.

  1. The clothing can be found on Fence, click the Services tab at the top.
  2. Please do not post errors about a missing package.json - it means you haven’t installed the mod properly. Please read the FAQs before asking for help.
  3. Please send me the content of your Logs folder - it contains information regarding your most recent launch of the server. Additionally, please send me your profile’s .json located within your /user/profiles/ folder.
  4. Yes, Fika works.
  5. If you are on SPT 4.0.0 or SPT 4.0.1: You can only find the clothing on Ragman, not Fence. The clothing can not be added to Fence on these versions.

KNOWN ISSUES:

  • Your first-person clothing model does not update when you enter the Hideout, only when you start a raid. This is a bug within EFT and unrelated to the mod. You can force a reload by attempting to start a raid and immediately backing out/canceling the loading.
  • Kaban’s clothing and head clip with a majority of clothing and rigs. A future patch will include an edited variant of these clothes to fit better (Kaban needs a weight loss plan).
  • The Zombie models are not playable. All of their models would need to be re-rigged to the player body, and the textures are far too low-resolution to be considered on par with the other clothing. (I don’t believe it is worth the effort.)

NON-ISSUES:

  • Other mods may affect what enemy PMCs wear - this is unrelated to this mod. If you see PMCs wearing scav clothing, please double-check what mods you have installed and check their config files for anything that may affect what clothing the AI are spawning with!
  • Arena clothing is unlocked at Ragman and paid for with GP coins and Lega medals. You can change the unlock requirements within the config.jsonc file, if you don’t use a mod that makes Lega medals available.

comments.author: RaiRaiTheRaichu Staff
comments.body_html:
i’m currently going through and recreating every first person arm bundle because many things have changed. if you try to hack together something “working” for 3.11.x, i can’t help you with troubleshooting. it is more complicated than replacing bundles even as a placeholder.

if you’re that desperate, you can try changing what bundle the game associates with each top.

(warning for all readers: here be dragons. this is untested, and many things are still going to break, such as the custom tops themselves. lots of things will be missing if you attempt to force the mod to load on 3.11.X. your profile is at extreme risk with a butchered port like this.)

open config.jsonc and search for the line:

“needKit”: {

for every top, you can change the ID of the hands the mesh is pointing to, by changing every one of these kinds of lines in this section:

“hands”: “66a257d21485fa5950d7c787”, // ID of hands to use in first person for this top

you can change the ID for the hands to something that actually exists. you can find the IDs in SPT\_Data/Server/database/templates/customization.json.

for example, if you want to set them all to use the “default” Scav hands, you can set them to the id for “SavageHands_feldparka”, which is “64ac23c449d74fd5ec0a124e”.

so replacing the “hands” entries for each top in config.jsonc with an existing hands entry in the customization database would override the mod’s first person hands being assigned to the tops.

again, i cannot recommend doing this. i understand the mod update is taking a long time, but i really must ask for patience while i work on this. i’m redoing a lot and redoing a lot correctly. the original mod was made very naively, and contains a lot of bad practices that evolved over time.
